tme.label: Effective average rate of the savings taxable base (%)
tme.errorInvalid: Enter the effective average rate from your draft between 0 and 100%, with at most two decimals.
tme.note: For {year} only. It is not saved and does not replace your tax return. Use the effective average rate of the savings taxable base (total net savings tax due divided by savings taxable base, times 100, with two decimals), not the general base one nor the whole return one. Source: Agencia Tributaria, Renta 2025 Manual, chapter 18, international double taxation deduction.

filing.fallbackReason: GerarAI has not calculated the Modelo 100 boxes for this portfolio and the engine returned no reason for the blockage. filing.fallbackBoxes: Boxes are only published for tax years whose mapping is verified against that year's ministerial order. No figures are shown for the rest: that mapping would have to be verified before trusting them.
